'''Medd Tandar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who lived during the [[Golden Age of the Old Republic]] where he served the [[Council of First Knowledge/Legends|Council of First Knowledge]] in their quest to locate and recover all remaining [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] following the [[New Sith Wars]]. 

==Biography==
Medd Tandar entered into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the tumultuous [[New Sith Wars]] and was able to survive the conflict thanks in part to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obba]]'s teachings and guidance. After serving as Obba's Padawan for sometime, Tandar was elevated to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and returned to the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] after the war ended. While the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] swept across the Republic, reform within the Order itself was well underway as [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Fae Coven]] championed steps to canonize Jedi doctrine and take the Jedi Order back to its monastic roots. Finding his place in a renewed era of Jedi history, Tandar became an agent of the [[Council of First Knowledge/Legends|Council of First Knowledge]], led by [[Caretaker of First Knowledge/Legends|Caretaker]] [[Restelly Quist/Legends|Restelly Quist]], and set out on missions to recover all existing [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] that survived the war.<ref name="DoE" />

In [[980 BBY]], the Council dispatched Jedi Tandar to [[Doan]] to recover a small cache of artifacts buried deep in a tomb beneath the surface. Imbued with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], Tandar could sense the artifacts as he approached and hoped to get them back to the Temple as soon as possible. While on Doan, Tandar was also assigned to negotiate with the [[Doan Royal House]] and the rebelling [[mining caste]] in hopes of preventing a civil war on the planet. During negotiations in a cavern under the planet's surface, Tandar met with caste Representative [[Gelba]] and five other miners and hoped to quickly end the conflict so he could recover the artifacts and return to Coruscant. As negotiations drew out, Tandar sensed a [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbance in the Force]] and opened himself up to the larger [[Living Force/Legends|Living Force]]. Sensing they were all in danger, Tandar did not react quick enough to protect the miners. An [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] female [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] known as [[Darth Cognus|the Huntress]] suddenly [[Massacre on Doan|ambushed]] the group, shooting and killing Gelba before assassinating the remaining workers.<ref name="DoE" />

Tandar once again attempted to open up to the Force very slowly; he reached out and [[Telekinesis/Legends|pulled]] the assassin's weapons free from her grasp. However, as she retreated he realized too late that this was a trap; the [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]] of the [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] had been set to overload. As they exploded, killing him, Tandar finally understood the true horror of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]].<ref name="DoE" />
